status: The layout spec for the sitting on the LVGL face: every drawn region names its word or composition, the states pose, place, confirm and begin, the focus as data, the events, the bottom line and the strings
note: The one home of the sitting's numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Sitting) and its wireframes 14-sitting-pose.svg to 14d-sitting-nav.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. The sitting spends a held sitting on one mibi: the player picks a pose from its habits and a place it has been, looks, and confirms. Its left half is Habitat's living window, unchanged, so the mibi stays where it stood; the choices are in the deck at the right (Habitat's right column, the namer's panel rectangle), the three steps along the foot. Every rectangle is on the 8 px grid.

notes.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false; UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29): every event on this screen is a cut to its end, so the host sends hold 0 and runs what follows an event's end (a hand-off, a jump, the next state) on the frame of the key; nothing waits on a still frame. The backdrop's dither is a cut; begin lands on one mibi up close, the ring on the Portrait module, on the frame of the second ✓, and its plate shows. A press that ends an event with `cut: true` also acts (habitat.json notes.cut); no event here cuts.
notes.where: its own screen under one mibi up close (frame.json navigation.screens.sitting: parent habitat, back {name}), opened from its Portrait module with ✓ Portray {name}, only while a sitting is held and the mibi can sit (sitting.portraitBlock empty: it has a habit seen and a place been)
notes.rules: prototypes/station/src/sitting.mjs: offer(st, m) gives the poses (the habits seen, habitsOf) and the places (where it has been, placesOf); beginSitting(st, m, pose, place) spends the held sitting and nothing else, sends the crate to the bay and sets the mibi's portrait painting. Nothing is spent before the last ✓
notes.window: the same bezel, glass, mibi box and name tag as Habitat, so the screen change keeps the mibi where it stood; the glass shows a plain backdrop, washed in the focused place's colours on the place step
notes.frame: the gilt frame around the window from the look-and-confirm step: the portrait to be. It lights when the confirm is armed
notes.visit: inside the screen ← keeps every choice; leaving the screen (← from the pose step, a room key) drops every choice, and coming back starts on the pose step with the ring on card.0
notes.order: the order of the cards is the frame's: poses in the species frame's habit order (the habits seen); places the pod's place first, then the order walked to (a bred mibi has only the places it walked to)
notes.amber: nothing on the sitting is amber

rules.closedList: station-layouts.md, The derived rules (closed): railCompaction slantTabs pageGrid platePosition listPitch splicePlan guideColumns pipGroups leafArc
rules.listPitch: the cards (three columns, two rows), the chosen cards and the three step tiles are lists by pitch: { first, pitch, grid }

stateRule: pose: pick one of the mibi's habits seen. place: pick one of the places it has been. confirm: look at the choice in the gilt frame and confirm, arm-then-confirm. begin: from the second ✓ until the screen changes to Habitat (events.begin), input held. ✓ on a card goes a step forward; ← goes a step back (from pose, to Habitat). A region with `inStates` exists only in those states

pictures.confirm: sitting-backdrop-{place}-544x408, the chosen place, seen through the gilt frame's opening

glass.load: the place backdrops load on entering the place step and are dropped on leaving the screen
glass.note: a plain stage in the vivarium's light; no words but the name tag

resident.asset: the mibi's standard painting (the portrait is not shown before it is painted)

nameTag.note: as on Habitat; not a target here

gilt.look: a modelled moulding 16 px deep on every side: outer bead 3 px, leaf face 8 px lit from the top left, inner shade lip 3 px, sight edge 2 px; lit is the leaf one value brighter with a 2 px warm sight edge; the sitting's gold, never the focus colour
gilt.standIn: colours.giltStandIn: the wireframes' stand-in until the masters land; the build draws only the masters
gilt.note: over the bezel; its opening sits 8 px inside the glass on every side, the mibi and its tag inside it

deck.note: the right column in every state: Habitat's card and modules column and the namer's panel rectangle

card.chosen: the card chosen before in this visit (on coming back a step): fill colours.card.chosen, one step up

cards.order: the frame's: pose, the habits seen in the species frame's habit order; place, the pod's place first, then the order walked to (a bred mibi: only the places it walked to)

chosen.note: the pose's card, then the place's card, as chosen; not targets

thumb.pictures: the chosen card's picture at 48: pose-{species}-{habit}-48x48 (hand-passed from the 96), place-{place}-48x48 (existing)

states.done: fill `panel`, the word `bone`, the chosen picture

backdrop.do: the place step: the ring moved to another place card; the backdrop cross-dithers to that place's (lvgl-switch.md §2.7). Entering the place step dithers from the plain backdrop to the focused place's; going back to the pose step dithers to the plain one

step.do: ✓ on a card or ← inside: the heading, the cards, the steps' tiles and the bottom line change on the frame of the key (cuts); the gilt frame shows on the confirm step (a cut)

begin.presses: the pad, ✓ and ← do nothing; a coloured key waits and acts when the hold ends (focus.held)

steps.do: the lit gilt frame dithers out: the frame leaves for the bay
the standard screen transition to Habitat, the ring on the Portrait module in its painting state; the message plate (home.plate)

begin.then: home: the plate on Habitat, Home's sitting slot and the Bay

pose.initial: the card chosen before in this visit, else card.0
pose.entry: card.0: opening the screen always starts here, no choice made (notes.visit)

card.id: card.<i>, i from 0 in the cards' order

confirm.armed: room: after the first ✓; regions.gilt.props.lit is focus.armed === "room"; any key but ✓ clears the arm
confirm.room: the ring on nothing: the gilt frame is the focus; ✓ arms, then begins

focus.held: while events.begin holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent but room:<x> (kept by the host and dispatched when the hold ends)

keys.pad: pose and place: moves the ring among the cards; confirm: nothing
keys.confirm: pose: this pose, then the place step; place: this place, then the confirm step; confirm: the first ✓ arms (the gilt frame lights), the second begins the sitting (events.begin)
keys.back: a step back, keeping the choice made there (the ring on it): confirm to place, place to pose; from pose, Habitat with the ring on the Portrait module (habitat.json focus.entry.backFromSitting), the choices dropped. Nothing is spent
keys.room: as everywhere (frame.json navigation.roomKeys); leaving drops every choice and nothing is spent, as on Create and Cross

bottomLine.backCap: the ← cap's x is 1008 − the word's width − 20 (the 16 px cap, 4 px, the word right-aligned to 1008): Habitat 54 px → 934, Pose 38 → 950, Place 42 → 946

masters.note: every master the sitting names, at the size it is shown; none is drawn by the build
list: pose-{species}-{habit}-96x96, one a habit of each species frame: the species' pose picture, never the mibi acting

strings.title: Sitting
strings.habits: the habit as an -ing phrase: "shaking dry", "calm", "sleeping curled", "sniffing", "puffing", "digging", "glowing"
strings.places: the place's word: "the meadow", "the pond edge", "the rock field", "the wood", "the cave"
strings.note: the frame's zones (station-layouts.md, The frame): a verb phrase of four words or fewer for the action, a label of six words or fewer for the context; no dot-joined parts; "Again: …" is the arm's wording

lines: strings.welcomePlate, only when begin gave a waiting welcome sitting (sitting.mjs beginSitting, checkWelcome)

example.note: Fig: the longer line plus 16 each side, rounded up to an even width to centre on x 512; it covers the strip, not the mibi's box or the Portrait module

slot.after: nothing; the gilt frame when begin gave a waiting welcome sitting (home.json regions.probe.slotRect)

bay.rule: from begin until it is opened, the sitting's crate stands in Cargo: on Home's Cargo module (home.json regions.cargo.sittingCrates) and in Cargo's bay (cargo.json regions.crates.sitting)

crate.slots: from the right: the first at [928, 72], a second at [864, 72]; walk crates fill from the left (800 + 64i); at most three crates show, walk crates first
crate.until: the walk crate's roles, no seal tag

lamp.lit: floor(10 × crateLamp) inner rows from the bottom in colours.crateLamp.lit, the rest colours.crateLamp.unlit; nine rows while painting or waiting for the cloud (LAMP_SHORT), ten when ready; never amber

bay.door: open while a sitting crate is in the bay, docked or away; shut only on an empty bay with the Companion away
bay.moduleLamp: home.json regions.cargo lamp (984, 60): amber only when a crate is ready to open (sitting.mjs bayState.amber: a ready sitting crate, or walk crates waiting while docked); otherwise off

buildChanges: the build has no sitting screen: sitting.mjs holds its rules headless (offer, beginBlock, beginSitting); habitat.mjs offers no Portray
Habitat's Portrait module (habitat.json regions.portrait) opens this screen with ✓ Portray {name}; begin returns to Habitat with the ring on it
sitting.mjs offer gives the poses in the order seen (habitsOf); the face orders them by the species frame's habits
home.json regions.bay draws no sitting crate and keeps the door shut while away; sitting.json home.bay is the Bay with a sitting crate
